note: Tradition → course → phase. Each phase loads one body preset + its sound. Play runs the timed visualisation.

courses.title: Matrika course — 50 sounds on the body

phases.title: Phase 1 — Round the body with sound
phases.desc: All 50 sounds in order, each on its body point. Follow along out loud.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Sounds alone
phases.desc: Same order, sound only. Feel each body point from memory.

phases.title: Phase 3 — Body point only
phases.desc: Touch a body point, name the sound. Both directions.

phases.title: Phase 4 — Small mantras: AUM, SO'HAM
phases.desc: Short combined movements over the installed body.

phases.title: Phase 5 — Full mantras: OM, OM NAMAH SHIVAYA
phases.desc: Long trajectories. Light follows the recorded sound.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Malini on the body
phases.desc: Same 50 sounds in Malini goddess order. Do after Matrika is stable.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Gaze (practice 24)
phases.desc: Fixed gaze with body-wide attention. Timed score with voice cues.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Six centres tour
phases.desc: Base to brow, one centre at a time.

phases.title: Phase 3 — Three knots
phases.desc: Base, heart, brow. Hold attention one slow breath each.

phases.title: Phase 4 — Ascent
phases.desc: Rising pulse base to crown, then rest.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Show the five centres
phases.desc: Column of five light centres on the body. No movement yet.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Descent of light
phases.desc: Light descends crown to feet. Timed.

phases.title: Phase 3 — Circulation
phases.desc: Light circulates round the body. Timed.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Open the lotus
phases.desc: Twelve-petal heart lotus. Tap petals for syllables.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Show the centres
phases.desc: Channel-wheel centres with counts. Study model only.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Breath energy
phases.desc: Seated figure, breath audio and spoken guidance.
